requested: review the collector then async runtime behavior-preserving decomposition plan

review.scope: Self-review of ownership, compatibility, lifecycle, dependency direction, and proof route; independent agent review unavailable under current coordination rules.

source_edits.scope: Bounded behavior-preserving collector then async runtime decomposition.

report_write.scope: Local design, plan, tests, and evidence receipts.

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first owner boundaries, thin scripts, explicit backend lifecycle, evidence-only claims, and near-risk validation apply.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Contract, IO/shadow, windows, transaction, async config, request collection, and worker resources each have one named owner.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Historical facades preserve public and diagnostic imports by object identity while caller knowledge does not grow.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The plan forbids reverse dependencies into facades, workflows, scripts, trainers, checkpoints, or visualization.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Oracle-shadow restoration stays in the IO transaction and resident worker acquisition/cleanup stays in the runtime owner.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Two serial extraction units stop before workflow, schema, model, loss, replay, or training changes.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: RED structure tests, focused behavior suites, impacted FADA tests, static checks, and explicit offline-only claims form the proof route.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Each extraction has RED structure identity, focused GREEN behavior, impacted regression, import smoke, lint, type, and final review checkpoints.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: All FADASourceBatch construction remains in a pure window owner with field-by-field regression coverage.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The extraction does not touch trainer, loss, optimizer, or replay update semantics.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Artifact commit remains one request transaction and checkpoint schemas are excluded from mutation.

residual_risks.description: The plan review is self-review because additional agent delegation is unavailable in the current coordination mode.
residual_risks.disposition: Run a fresh final-gate self-review with validated receipt and report the lack of independent review.
